  cd /home/promano/GitHub/slack-update
  STEP=phase-1-operational-live-revocation-decision-review
  bash "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh"

  git add -- CHANGELOG.md \
    "docs/reference/$STEP.md" \
    "tools/reference/$STEP.py" \
    "tests/reference/test-$STEP-harness.sh" \
    "tests/fixtures/reference/acceptance/phase-1/$STEP"-{confirmed379,step379-user-acceptance,dossier,sources,policy}.json

  git diff --cached --check
  git commit -m "Phase 1 step 380: review live revocation enforcement and counterexamples"
  git push
  git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
  git log -1 --oneline
  git log -1 --oneline origin/main
)
